First, note the given date: 05-02-1137 (likely DD-MM-YYYY format → 5th February 1137).  
Subtract 25 weeks and 7 days = 25 weeks + 1 week = 26 weeks total.  
26 weeks = 26 × 7 = 182 days.  

Subtract 182 days from 5th February 1137:  
1137 is a common year (not divisible by 4 in the Julian calendar? Actually 1137 is before 1582, so we use proleptic Gregorian as instructed, but leap year rule same: divisible by 4 → 1136 leap, 1137 not leap).  

From 5 Feb back 182 days:  
Go back 5 days → 31 Jan 1137.  
Back 31 more days → 31 Dec 1136.  
Remaining days: 182 − 5 − 31 = 146 days left to go back from 31 Dec 1136.  

December 1136 has 31 days, November 30, October 31, September 30, August 31, July 31, June 30, May 31, April 30, March 31, February 29 (1136 leap year), January 31.  

From 31 Dec 1136:  
Back 31 days (Dec) → 30 Nov 1136.  
Back 30 days (Nov) → 31 Oct 1136.  
Back 31 days (Oct) → 30 Sep 1136.  
Back 30 days (Sep) → 31 Aug 1136.  
Back 31 days (Aug) → 31 Jul 1136.  
Days subtracted so far: 31+30+31+30+31 = 153 days from 31 Dec 1136. That’s too many (we only needed 146). Let’s recount carefully.  

Better: 182 days before 5 Feb 1137:  
Count back:  
Jan 1137: 31 days, but from 5 Feb back to 1 Feb = 4 days, then Jan 31 days = 35 days back to 1 Jan 1137.  
182 − 35 = 147 days before 1 Jan 1137 (i.e., into 1136).  

From 1 Jan 1136 back 147 days:
